title: Terminal settings
themeHint: Applies to all connections in all workspaces.
fontHint: A font that is not installed silently falls back to Consolas – then nothing looks different from before.
minimumContrastHint: Brightens foreground colors that are too dark until they stand out – against programs that write dark blue on black.
scrollbackHint: Lines kept above the screen, and therefore searchable. Only costs memory.
boldBrightHint: Off looks calmer: bold stays bold instead of also changing color.
